recorded: Every case passed 10 runs against the original with Node.js 26.12.1, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.27.1, and zod 3.25.76, run unchanged as node src/index.ts, the file npm start runs with type stripping. The server always calls the legacy API at http://localhost:9999/v1, so the services build and run the lesson's nodejs-fastify-mongodb-crud from its compose file, on Node.js 20.11, with MongoDB 9.0.4 from the mongo image at latest, publishing the API on port 9999, which must be free, and leaving MongoDB unpublished. An override passed on standard input names both containers, drops the bind mounts, so the API runs the code its image copied and writes nothing into the course folder, and adds a health check on /v1/health, so the cases start once the API answers. It needs Docker Compose 2.24.4 or later, and the built image goes away with the containers. Every case deletes the customers it creates, so each starts from an empty collection. ObjectIds are generated, so the cases check 24 lowercase hex digits and compare later answers with the ids the server returned. Texts that hold JSON are compared by value, so spacing and key order are free. Tools and the prompt's arguments are compared in any order, the prompt's arguments by name and description, since an optional argument may leave out required, get_customer's nullable customer in the output schema by its description, since each SDK writes nullability its own way, and capabilities by presence. The answers the API gives to an unchanged update, a missing phone, or a malformed id may come back with isError false or without it, never true. Invalid arguments and unknown tools may come back as a tool result with isError or as a JSON-RPC error with code -32602, and the lookup of a malformed _id as a tool result with isError or any JSON-RPC error. No case deletes a well-formed id that matches nothing, since the legacy API never answers it.

services.up:
docker compose -f ../nodejs-fastify-mongodb-crud/docker-compose.yml -f - -p stackfy-06-legacy-api-mcp-z up -d --wait <<'EOF'
services:
  api01-test:
    container_name: stackfy-06-legacy-api-mcp-z-api
    volumes: !reset []
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'wget', '-qO', '/dev/null', 'http://127.0.0.1:9999/v1/health']
      interval: 1s
      retries: 60
  mongodb:
    container_name: stackfy-06-legacy-api-mcp-z-mongodb
    ports: !reset []
EOF
